name: Zaru (zaru-cli)
description: Terminal agent harness that runs model-requested tool calls behind permission prompts, loops on project validators, and logs every step to a JSONL transcript.
compatibility: Ollama server at localhost:11434 by default, with no API key.
Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions server; Google Gemini API keys are an optional hosted backend.
limitations: Pre-alpha with no releases or packages; built from source with Rust 1.98.1 and a C compiler, and commands, files and settings can change without notice.
Built and tested on Linux only; does not build on Windows, and macOS is untested.
Not a sandbox: tool calls run with the user's permissions, and a permission prompt does not limit what an allowed call can do.
The model provider receives the task, conversation, tool descriptions and every tool result, including file contents and command output.
Ollama defaults to a 4,096-token context window; set provider.ollama.context_tokens to request more, capped by the model's reported limit.

sources.note: Documents the Ollama, OpenAI-compatible and Gemini providers, Linux-only support, pre-alpha status, permission prompts, the validator loop, the JSONL transcript, the not-a-sandbox warning and what the provider receives.
